feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 9 June 2026 4:13pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 09 June 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the northwest of the British Isles as a trough continues to clear the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 in the east at first, soon decreasing 3 or 4 in most waters.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon becoming slight.


##Weather##

Occasional showers soon becoming isolated.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 2 to 4, occasionally 5 in the east at first, backing south or southwest 5 to 7 overnight into Thursday, veering southwest 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming mainly moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Isolated showers to start, then occasional rain or drizzle arriving from the west.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
